### Added

- (agent-platform) [Workspace-manager client over muster, no UI](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2908) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — No visible change yet: the Agent Platform can now call workspace-manager's tools through muster as the signed-in person, the groundwork for workspace pages and for checking repository access when a Session starts.
- (gs) [Sort and filter the catalog by Architect Orb Version](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2898) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In the catalog, the column and the sidebar filter for the build toolchain are both named `Architect Orb Version`. The column sorts the newest orb release to the top, and the filter is a dropdown like Owner and Tags, newest version first.

### Fixed

- (gs-node) [Answer structuredContent where a tool's text is prose](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2901) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a tool's page in the Agent Platform's MCP Servers tab, a tool that answers structured data next to a short summary shows the data, such as `{"workspaces":[]}`, instead of the summary `0 workspaces`.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.95.3...v2.96.0
